LEG 2 (tarotMinorId producer) is PARTIAL and the old note overstated it: the producer function ALREADY EXISTS (portal-core/src/m3_transcription_bridge.rs:638 minor_arcana_id_from_codon, used at :427) and the 56-card LUT is kernel-owned (epi-lib/include/m3.h:565 M3_MINOR_ARCANA_COUNT 56); the real gap is a wiring gap in the clock projection, which still stubs (portal-core/src/kernel/projections/binary.rs:28,:67 tarot_minor_id: None; baseline-profile.json:15094,15123 null).
